clips.title: The story
paras: The Verdant Note is a summons delivered to novice tauren druids in Camp Narache. Sent on behalf of the druid mentor Gart Mistrunner, it instructs young initiates to report for training and begin learning the rites of the Earthmother.

Young tauren who demonstrate a spiritual affinity for nature receive the Verdant Note shortly after beginning their trials in the Red Cloud Mesa. Carried by a messenger sent by Gart Mistrunner, the brief missive directs the initiate to present themselves to the mentor at Camp Narache. Restless spirits and shifting elements have begun troubling Mulgore, making the instruction of new druids an urgent duty for the elders.

Upon answering the note, initiates are inducted into the deeper mysteries of nature communion. Gart Mistrunner cautions young druids that although night elves share a common bond with the wild, their ancient pride keeps them distant and unwelcoming. Tauren druidism focuses strictly on reverence for the Earthmother, guiding initiates to listen to the land's restless ancestral voices and serve as her living instruments.
